conventions.model: Kerr-only NLSE i u_xi - u_tautau/2 + N^2|u|^2 u = 0, u0 = exp(-tau^2/2), xi from weights_grid_for_solver.json; solver realization T0 = 1 ps, beta2 = 1 ps^2/m, gamma = 1 /W/m, omega0 T0 = 1e9 (s = 1e-9), NoRaman()
conventions.grid: claude-b's grid: Nt over a 40 T0 window (512 for N = 5, 10; 1024 for N = 20); steps nsteps = max(4000, N^2 xi / 0.002 rounded up to 1000)
conventions.weights: claude-b bin k on solver bin -k (mirror); F_w = Var(N_w) / sum_k w_k^2 nbar_k, Var from solve_adjoint(...; adjoint_mode=:discrete_rk4ip)
conventions.bandwidth_ratio: var_in/var_out of the photon-number spectrum over the whole grid, (Omega T0)^2 about each spectrum's own mean
conventions.F_centroid_full_grid: centroid weight extended to every grid bin, w = -(Omega T0) + offset (offset = mean of w_centroid - k 2pi/40 over the given bins)
